name: Echo wash
description: The current song is fed into a tempo-synced echo over its last bars, then cut on the phrase line; its echoes keep repeating and fading while the next song starts right underneath them. Nothing is time-stretched, so it works between any two songs, whatever their tempos, and it covers a change of tempo or key gracefully. Longer, louder echoes make it more dramatic; short ones make it a quick flourish.
author: Muisc

riseBars.label: Echo build
riseBars.doc: Over how many bars before the cut the echo is turned up

sendMax.label: Echo amount
sendMax.doc: How much of the old song goes into the echo at the cut

echoTime.label: Echo time
echoTime.doc: 2 = half a beat, 3 = a dotted eighth, 4 = one beat

feedback.label: Echo repeats
feedback.doc: How much of each echo comes back; higher repeats longer

tailBars.label: Tail
tailBars.doc: How many bars the echoes ring under the new song before it plays alone
